using CUDA, LinearAlgebra, JSON3
CUDA.allowscalar(false)
function main()
    r = Dict{String,Any}()
    t(k, f) = try r[k] = f() catch e; r[k] = "ERR: " * first(sprint(showerror, e), 90) end
    for T in (Float32, Float64)
        for n in (16, 4096)
            a = CUDA.CuArray(ones(T, n)); b = CUDA.CuArray(fill(T(2), n))
            t("dot_$(T)_$(n)",        () -> LinearAlgebra.dot(a, b))
            t("sumabs2_$(T)_$(n)",    () -> sum(abs2, a))
            t("mapreduce_$(T)_$(n)",  () -> mapreduce(*, +, a, b))
        end
    end
    t("norm_f64", () -> LinearAlgebra.norm(CUDA.CuArray(ones(Float64, 16))))
    println(JSON3.write(Dict("probe" => r)))
end
main()
